body: Most prices start from > 0, which causes annoying decimal values at the middle. This PR fixes that by always rounding the middle value to a whole number Maybe not a complete fix for #2275, but definitely related to the underlying reason. version|result ---|--- before| after|

https://deploy-preview-2276--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

When I did this, I wanted to correct the issues with the rangeSlider from v1 which was not placing the middle pit at the correct middle.

And also, to provide support for negatives values which was a nightmare for the v1.

What I purpose, is to use the `precision` parameter to know at what decimal we should round for the start/middle/end pit value.

What do you think?
Having this as an argument seems good to me. Precision as number of digits after 0, defaulting to 1?
Yes exactly, the default value is 2 👍
Pit has now got a `precision` Prop, how do we expose it to the users, via `Slider`?
@Haroenv what's the status on this? If you don't have time to take care of it for the moment, do you mind if I close the PR?

title: fix(Pit): round the middle value to the whole number
